This horror is scripted. Your goosebumps are not.
"Nails" by William Lott
Three ambitious true crime podcasters prepare for their biggest episode yet, featuring Charlie Baker, the sole survivor of a brutal attack by a mysterious serial killer - The Beast. However, their pursuit of recognition collides with the very horror they've been chronicling when they find themselves fighting to survive against a terrifying figure that may be The Beast himself.
